subject: general
question: Where is the 60th All India Conference of Directors General and Inspectors General of Police being held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nawa Raipur, Chhattisgarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi is chairing the **60th All India Conference of DGPs and IGPs** at the Indian Institute of Management, Nawa Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The three-day conference was inaugurated by **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, who called it a “portal of solutions” for internal security.
 
• The theme of the 2025 conference is **“Viksit Bharat: Security Dimensions.”**
 
• Key discussions include **Left-Wing Extremism, counter-terrorism, disaster management, women’s safety, and the use of AI and forensic science** in policing.
 
• The event features participation from **NSA Ajit Doval**, DGPs of all states and UTs, and heads of Central Police Organisations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Key Highlights from Amit Shah’s Address**__

 __
 
• Emphasised the importance of **accurate intelligence**, clarity in objectives, and coordinated action.
 
• Noted India’s progress in the last 11 years against **radicalisation, extremism, insurgency, and narcotics.**
 
• Stated that the conference will help in creating a **Roadmap for Policing towards Viksit Bharat**.
 
 
 
• **Awards Presented**__
 __
 
• Police Medals for Meritorious Service.
 
• Trophies for the **three best Police Stations** in India.
 
• The Prime Minister will also present the **President’s Police Medal for Distinguished Service**.
 
 
 
• **Focus Areas of Discussion**__
 __
 
• Counter-terrorism strategies for modern threats.
 
• Use of **forensic science, AI tools**, and smart policing systems.
 
• Women’s safety and integrated disaster management.
 
 
 
• **Conference Significance**__
 
 
• A platform for high-level policy planning and national security reviews.
 
• Shapes long-term security strategies for a **developed India by 2047**.
 
• Brings together top national security leadership under one forum.
